title: OneLife
description: a mod to allow Toggling hardcore on/off, plus some other features
body:
Adds a fully toggleable Hardcore system to any non‑Hardcore world.
This mod introduces the /onelife command, letting you switch players into or out of Hardcore on the fly without restarting the world.

It also includes several custom items that let you:

- remove the OneLife curse
  
- revive eliminated players
  
- grant new OneLife status to others

If you want players to craft the OneLife Sword, make sure to enable the gamerule:

/gamerule CanCraftSword true

Enjoy the chaos — responsibly.
